scope: All 39 residual unaccented pored/Pored/poredok/Poredok/poredku tokens in the live v019 Latin reader, all in base-papers1-43-isv.tex.
choice: Normalize the complete family to official poręd/Poręd and porędok/Porędok/porędku while preserving capitalization, inflection, meaning, and sentence structure.
motivation: The official type-1 dictionary entries are poręd for beside/next to and porędȯk for order/sequence. All 39 sites instantiate exactly those meanings. The unaccented family was an inconsistent surface layer beside already-canonical poręd forms, so retaining it supplied no semantic or intelligibility benefit.
alternatives_rejected: Retain pored as a South-Slavic surface variant: the official bridge is poręd, already used productively in the same reader.
Recast the preposition as kromě: that means except rather than beside/in addition to.
Rewrite each beside construction syntactically: the exact official preposition permits a morphology-only correction without semantic disturbance.

accepted_entries: id 5198 poręd (+2), preposition type 1, beside/next to

evidence.semantic_review: All 34 prepositional sites mean beside, along with, or in addition to; all five noun sites mean order/sequence. No protected literal, title, citation, or different-sense site exists.

validation.coverage: 39/39 source sites mapped by exact case-sensitive histogram
validation.protected_spans: TeX comments and foreign-language arguments unchanged
validation.structure: TeX controls, labels/references/citations, braces, math delimiters, and line counts unchanged
